question: Who is regarded as the chief architect of India’s Green Revolution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**MS Swaminathan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **MS Swaminathan**, an eminent Indian geneticist and agricultural scientist, is regarded as the chief architect of the Green Revolution in India.
 
• He is known for introducing and promoting the use of high-yielding variety (HYV) seeds and advanced agricultural techniques, which significantly increased agricultural productivity in India during the 1960s and 1970s.
 
• Swaminathan worked closely with Nobel laureate Norman Borlaug and facilitated the adaptation of Mexican wheat varieties to Indian climatic conditions.
 
• His efforts helped India achieve self-sufficiency in food production and reduced dependence on food imports, especially during times of famine.
 
• He was the founder of the **MS Swaminathan Research Foundation (MSSRF)**, which focuses on sustainable agriculture, food security, and rural development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dr. Manmohan Singh**

 
 
• He was the 13th Prime Minister of India, serving from 2004 to 2014.
 
• Dr. Singh is a renowned economist and played a key role in the economic liberalization of India in 1991 as the Finance Minister under PV Narasimha Rao's government.
 
• He is credited with introducing reforms that opened up India's economy to globalization and foreign investment.
 
 
 
• **PV Narasimha Rao**
 
 
• Rao served as the 9th Prime Minister of India from 1991 to 1996.
 
• He is often referred to as the "Father of Indian Economic Reforms" for initiating landmark liberalization policies that transformed India's economy.
 
• His tenure is also marked by significant political and economic reforms, including the dismantling of the License Raj.
 
 
 
• **Dr. Verghese Kurien**
 
 
• Known as the "Father of the White Revolution in India," Dr. Kurien was instrumental in making India the largest producer of milk in the world.
 
• He spearheaded the **Operation Flood** program, which revolutionized India's dairy industry and strengthened rural economies.
 
• Dr. Kurien was the founder of the **National Dairy Development Board (NDDB)** and the architect of the Amul brand.
